title: quest task list --across-refs truncation reason names a source path the installed CLI does not ship
description: Found by the independent review of QCLI-417 (finding N-a, 2026-09-29), relayed by the implementer with the reviewer own wording. The truncation reason emitted when gh pr list returns rows at --limit ends: "or raise OPEN_PULL_REQUEST_LIMIT in src/adapters/refs/gh-ref-discovery.ts". The actionable half (--ref <ref> or --pr <N>) is correct for every reader, but the source path exists only in a checkout: an installed-CLI user has no such file. The reviewer verified the message is otherwise accurate, single-line, and asserted by tests, so this is a wording fix, not a defect fix. Fix direction: keep the remedy clause valid for both audiences, or state that the limit is a source-level constant without naming a repository path; update the asserted string in the focused test.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The truncation reason offers a remedy valid for an installed-CLI user (or states the limit is a source-level constant without naming a repository path), and the focused QCLI-417 test asserts the final wording.

plan: Replace the repository-path clause in the truncation reason with wording that states the limit is a source-level constant and names no repository path.
Update the focused QCLI-417 test to assert the final wording and the absence of any source path.
Run the focused test and the repository check; commit, complete QCLI-418 in the same PR, push and open it.
Independent review via review-assignment; record it; land via opum-control task land.
finalSummary: Wording fix. The --across-refs truncation reason ended "raise OPEN_PULL_REQUEST_LIMIT in src/adapters/refs/gh-ref-discovery.ts" -- a repository path that exists only in a checkout, so an installed-CLI user was handed a remedy they cannot follow. It now ends "raise the OPEN_PULL_REQUEST_LIMIT constant from a source checkout": the --ref/--pr remedy is unchanged and valid for every reader, and the limit is named as a source-level constant with no repository path. The focused QCLI-417 test asserts the final wording and the absence of any source path (.ts, src/), so the old string fails it.
